description: Figure 5 illustrates the average number of likes for headlines across different season groups using a single vertical bar chart. The category axis is horizontal and corresponds to season-group categories (the specific category labels are not legible at this page resolution), while the value axis is vertical and represents average likes on a linear numeric scale (exact axis label and tick values are not readable). The plot contains one bar per season group, all rendered in a uniform light gray fill with no visible stacking or grouping within bars and no legend; the bars appear to be of similar height, with no clearly readable numeric annotations. The bars do not appear to be explicitly sorted (ordering cannot be confirmed from the unreadable labels), and there is no visible emphasis such as highlighting, outlines, or callout labels on any individual bar.
